description: This Java class 'Scheduler' manages task scheduling, execution, and shutdown for the MockServer project, including handling delays, synchronous/asynchronous execution, and logging.

classes.name: Scheduler
classes.description: Main class for scheduling and executing tasks with support for delays, synchronous/asynchronous modes, and logging.

classes.name: Scheduler.SchedulerThreadFactory
classes.description: Custom thread factory for creating scheduler threads with specific naming and daemon settings.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the scheduler, waiting up to 500 milliseconds for termination.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a Runnable command with optional port setting and exception logging.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a command to run after specified delays, supporting synchronous and asynchronous execution.

methods.name: addDelays
methods.description: Combines multiple Delay objects into a single Delay representing total delay time.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits a Runnable task for execution, with optional synchronous mode.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits a task with a flag for synchronous execution.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits a task with a future, handling response timeout and exceptions.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits a CompletableFuture task, handling response timeout and exceptions.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits a task with a callback consumer, handling response and exceptions.
